description: UGC creator workflow for paid UGC campaigns (Content Rewards on Whop and similar marketplaces, paid per 1,000 views) posted on the creator's own TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. The creator films; the agent turns the campaign brief into a checked checklist with a GO, NO-GO or REFUSED verdict (rate, minimum, cap, fee, budget, geo, formats, talking points, banned words, CTA, tags, links, disclosure window, pre-approval, deadline), writes the script in the creator's voice with 3 to 5 hooks and every claim tagged and checked (experience lines confirmed true, brand claims traced to the brief), a shot list per format, edits what the creator filmed locally (talking head, split screen with the brand's footage, face plus screen recording, hands and b-roll with the creator's voiceover) keeping the last full try of each line, with captions and the "Ad" label on screen, or takes the creator's own finished edit, checks every video and what the creator actually says against the brief and the platforms, shows one plan page, posts through WoopSocial after one yes bound to the exact files, prints each post's 30-minute submission deadline, and keeps a ledger of submissions, approvals, rejections, appeals, payouts, hours and honest earnings per hour. Never generates or alters a person, face or voice. Use when someone says "I got a UGC campaign", "write my UGC script", "UGC brief", "Content Rewards UGC", "Whop UGC campaign", "edit my UGC video", "split screen UGC", "post my UGC to TikTok, Reels and Shorts", "track my UGC payouts" or "is this UGC campaign worth it". Standalone.
